conditions: TA = 25 C unless a fact states its own condition; electrical characteristics at TJ = 25 C unless stated. Facts apply to the AO3400A die in the SOT-23 (3-lead) package.

sections: Figure 9 Maximum Forward Biased Safe Operating Area (printed p. 4)

id_max_a.condition: continuous drain current at TA = 25 C, VGS = 10 V, TJ limited; 4.7 A at TA = 70 C; the package is the limiting element

id_pulsed_max_a.condition: pulsed drain current, repetitive rating with pulse width limited by TJ(max) = 150 C (note C)

pd_max_w.condition: power dissipation at TA = 25 C based on TJ(max) = 150 C using the <= 10 s junction-to-ambient thermal resistance (note B); 0.9 W at TA = 70 C
pd_max_w.source: AO3400A, Absolute Maximum Ratings (printed p. 1) and note B (printed p. 2)

rds_on_ohm.condition: TJ = 25 C, <300 us pulse, duty cycle <= 0.5 % (note E)
TJ = 125 C (same VGS = 10 V, ID = 5.7 A row)
TJ = 25 C, <300 us pulse, duty cycle <= 0.5 % (note E)
TJ = 25 C, <300 us pulse, duty cycle <= 0.5 % (note E); this is the lowest VGS at which a maximum RDS(ON) is specified

vgs_th_min_v.condition: VDS = VGS, ID = 250 uA, TJ = 25 C. WARNING: threshold is the onset of conduction, NOT proof of full enhancement - a module must use RDS(ON) at the actual applied VGS, never VGS(th), as the on-state proof

vgs_th_max_v.condition: VDS = VGS, ID = 250 uA, TJ = 25 C; typical 1.05 V. WARNING: threshold is not a guarantee that the channel is fully enhanced at a given gate voltage, and VGS(th) falls further at hot (roughly -2 mV/C order); no on-state conclusion may be drawn from it

qg_typ_c.condition: total gate charge Qg at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 15 V, ID = 5.7 A; typical 6 nC, maximum 7 nC

qg_max_c.condition: maximum total gate charge at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 15 V, ID = 5.7 A

qgs_typ_c.condition: gate-source charge at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 15 V, ID = 5.7 A (1.3 nC typical)

qgd_typ_c.condition: gate-drain charge at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 15 V, ID = 5.7 A (1.8 nC typical)

ciss_typ_f.condition: input capacitance at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 15 V, f = 1 MHz (630 pF typical)

coss_typ_f.condition: output capacitance at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 15 V, f = 1 MHz (75 pF typical)

crss_typ_f.condition: reverse transfer capacitance at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 15 V, f = 1 MHz (50 pF typical)

rg_typ_ohm.condition: internal gate resistance at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz (minimum 1.5 ohm, maximum 4.5 ohm)

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: steady-state maximum junction-to-ambient thermal resistance, device mounted on 1 in^2 FR-4 board with 2 oz copper, still air, TA = 25 C (note A); typical 100 C/W. The <= 10 s value is 90 C/W max (70 C/W typical) and power dissipation is rated using that <= 10 s value
theta_ja_c_per_w.source: AO3400A, Thermal Characteristics (printed p. 1) and note A (printed p. 2)

theta_ja_10s_c_per_w.condition: maximum junction-to-ambient thermal resistance for t <= 10 s, 1 in^2 FR-4 2 oz copper, still air (typical 70 C/W); this is the condition used for the PD rating
theta_ja_10s_c_per_w.source: AO3400A, Thermal Characteristics (printed p. 1) and note B (printed p. 2)

theta_jl_c_per_w.condition: steady-state maximum junction-to-lead thermal resistance (typical 63 C/W)

tj_max_c.condition: maximum operating junction temperature; junction and storage temperature range -55 C to +150 C

body_diode.value: yes - integrated body diode; VSD 0.7 V typical and 1.0 V maximum at IS = 1 A, VGS = 0 V; maximum body-diode continuous current 2 A; trr 8.5 ns typical and Qrr 2.6 nC typical at IF = 5.7 A, dI/dt = 100 A/us
body_diode.condition: characterised at TJ = 25 C; body-diode current rating 2 A continuous is below the channel rating
body_diode.source: AO3400A, Electrical Characteristics VSD, IS, trr, Qrr (printed p. 2)

vf_body_diode_max_v.condition: body-diode forward voltage at IS = 1 A, VGS = 0 V (typical 0.7 V)

trr_body_diode_typ_s.condition: body-diode reverse recovery time typical at IF = 5.7 A, dI/dt = 100 A/us (8.5 ns); Qrr 2.6 nC typical
trr_body_diode_typ_s.source: AO3400A, Electrical Characteristics trr, Qrr (printed p. 2)

soa.value: datasheet provides a forward-bias safe operating area (Figure 9) for TA = 25 C and TJ(max) = 150 C, single pulse, curves at DC/10 s/1 ms/.../10 us; the DC boundary is RDS(ON)-limited at low VDS and thermally limited at high VDS (note F). No unclamped inductive switching (UIS/EAS) rating is given
soa.condition: single-pulse SOA only; repetitive operation requires the transient thermal impedance curves (Figure 11)
soa.source: AO3400A, Figure 9 and note F (printed pp. 2, 4)

bvdss_min_v.condition: drain-source breakdown voltage at ID = 250 uA, VGS = 0 V

idss_max_a.condition: zero-gate-voltage drain current at VDS = 30 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 25 C (1 uA); 5 uA at TJ = 55 C

vgss_leakage_max_a.condition: gate-body leakage current at VDS = 0 V, VGS = +/-12 V (100 nA)

id_on_min_a.condition: on-state drain current at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 5 V (minimum 30 A)

gfs_typ_s.condition: forward transconductance at VDS = 5 V, ID = 5.7 A (33 S typical)

unknown_facts: No maximum RDS(ON) is specified at VGS = 4.5 V or 2.5 V for TJ = 125 C; only the VGS = 10 V row has a 125 C maximum (38 mohm). A hot low-VGS on-resistance can therefore not be read from this datasheet.
No on-state resistance is specified for VGS below 2.5 V; the transfer characteristic (Figure 2) is typical only. Operation from a 1.8 V logic rail is not characterised by a guaranteed RDS(ON).
No unclamped inductive switching (UIS) / EAS rating is stated, so inductive-load avalanche behaviour is unverified.
No gate-charge or switching-loss data is given at VGS = 2.5 V or 10 V drive for the switching times; Qg is specified only at VGS = 4.5 V.
No junction-to-ambient thermal resistance for an arbitrary user PCB is stated - only the JEDEC/reference 1 in^2 FR-4 2 oz copper board condition; a real board value must be measured or modelled.
notes: Verified against the current AOS datasheet served at the URL above on 2026-10-27 (Rev 3.1, July 2023). The RDS(ON) table in the PDF prints values in mohm (the text layer shows 'mW' because of a font-encoding issue); the ohm values recorded here are the mohm numbers divided by 1000. The four specified points are VGS = 10 V / ID = 5.7 A (26.5 mohm max at 25 C), VGS = 10 V at 125 C (38 mohm max), VGS = 4.5 V / ID = 5 A (32 mohm max) and VGS = 2.5 V / ID = 3 A (48 mohm max). VGS(th) 0.65-1.45 V is a threshold, not a drive requirement: at VGS = 2.5 V the part is specified at a maximum RDS(ON) of 48 mohm, so a low-side switch fed by a 3.3 V GPIO (VGS approx 3.3 V) is inside the characterised range between the 2.5 V and 4.5 V points, but a generator must not interpolate or claim a number the datasheet does not state. Steady-state theta_JA 125 C/W means PD = 1.4 W is only valid with the <= 10 s thermal resistance.
